pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
One of the best ways to learn a language is through conversation.  We can talk about everyday life or any topics that interest you.  Don't know what to talk about? No problem! We can use conversation cards with random topics, or we can play fun games that promote conversation. 

Do you like homework?  Me too!  Your time is valuable, and homework helps you get the most out of class time. I enjoy sending a short article or video before each class.  You can choose a topic that you are interested in, or I can choose the topic. Then I will bring some interesting discussion questions to class so we will always have something unique to talk about.  The homework is always optional, but it helps you get the most out of our time together.

This is a relaxed type of class. Mistakes are a part of the learning process and allow us to grow. 
I encourage you to take risks, make mistakes, and enjoy the process. Throughout the class, I will take notes on a shared Google Doc with suggestions to help you sound more like a native speaker, as well as new words and phrases.  This way, you can review after class.

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you looking for a structured plan that will take you to the next level? Then this class is for you! This course follows a logical sequence. First we will learn new vocabulary words, practice seeing them in context, then practice using them out loud.  We will also cover all the grammar points necessary in order to master the English language.

Since these are private lessons, they are 100% customized to your needs.  Not sure when to use the past perfect? Then we can start with the past perfect.  Or would you rather focus on vocabulary related to business?  You're the boss.  During your first lesson, we will create a learning plan to help you accomplish your goals. But if you're not sure where to start, I can do a short assessment of your current level, and help you decide where to begin.  

This course typically involves reading, writing, speaking, and listening exercises. In order to get the most out of your class time, most of the reading, writing, and listening exercises are given as homework.  This way, we can spend more time speaking during class.  And of course, we will focus more on the skills that are most relevant to your goals.

pro_course_detail.title: TOEFL, IELTS, CAE, and Duolingo Test Prep
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed to help you achieve the best score possible on whichever English proficiency exam you are preparing for.  Using practice exams as a guide, we will pinpoint any weaknesses and fine-tune them.

Before the first class, please send me a message informing me which exam you will be taking and the exam date. This way, we can create a study plan that is specific to your needs. If your exam date is soon, we can get down to business by practicing the speaking portion of the exam, linking words, and exam tips.  If you have several weeks to prepare, we can cover all four portions of the exam. If you have several months to prepare, we can even follow a textbook.

I work with my students to develop a plan for them to reach their goals and I help keep them on target for achieving those goals.

course_info.trial_description:
A Trial Lesson is a half hour lesson where we introduce ourselves and I learn more about your level of English and your goals for improving. I will give you an assessment and feedback and suggest how you can improve with me and outside of lessons. 
Before the Trial Lesson, it is helpful for me to know what is your English level and what your goals are for improving.

pro_course_detail.title: IMPROVE! - Grammar,  Pronunciation,  Vocabulary, Writing, Reading, Listening, Speaking
pro_course_detail.description: Are looking to improve your English for work, travel, family, hobby or other? I will make the learning interesting, enjoyable and rewarding by weaving together skills with practical speaking and conversation. If you are very committed to working outside of classes I can give you relevant homework to help you learn more quickly. I will give you my best effort to help you reach your goals!

pro_course_detail.title: CONVERSATION ONLY! Improve your skills (organizing thoughts, vocabulary, grammar) while speaking conversationally.
pro_course_detail.description: Don't stay stuck on a plateau - improve your fluency and advance your level of speaking while engaging in useful, interesting and practical conversations. Use ALL the grammar & vocabulary you already know!! Learn from pronunciation, grammar and word choice corrections. Find better or more appropriate ways to express yourself. Prepare for real situations.  Expand your vocabulary. For advanced students - discover exactly how a native speaker would express something. You should dedicate 10% of your time studying and 90% practicing speaking what you have learned. I will provide you with interesting topics to speak about or you can. I will make the time rich, enjoyable and rewarding.

pro_course_detail.title: BUSINESS ENGLISH & INTERVIEW PREPARATION - Communication, presentations, meetings, business writing, negotiations, small talk, socializing
pro_course_detail.description: Strengthen your proficiency in Business English to more effectively and fluently communicate in English in daily workplace scenarios such as presentations, negotiations, meetings, small talk, writing reports and socializing. I will help you meet your specific business English goals or I can take you through all that you should know to be truly proficient in your business interactions in English. I give my students 100% of my effort and focus so that the learning is interesting, rewarding and enjoyable while they are reaching their goals.
